apps.name: Sony Amp DSP
apps.subtitle: Auto USB-C to 3.5mm Line-Driver Pre-Amp & 10-Band EQ
apps.localizedDescription: Automatically detects the iPhone 16 USB-C to 3.5mm DAC adapter and engages a 32-bit floating-point +7.5dB to +12dB Pre-Amp Line-Driver Boost (0.5Vrms -> 2.0Vrms) with Apple CoreAudio Brickwall Peak Limiting, 65Hz Sony MegaBass Sub-Harmonic Exciter, 10-band Parametric EQ, and direct TrueNAS Navidrome Subsonic streaming.
